title: Not exactly "mall world" but rooted in similar concepts
content: Since I was a child I've had a deeply disturbing recurring dream. It's not set in nearly as fantastical a setting, but I've had a few people say that they've experienced something similar and wanted to see if anyone here had any thoughts? Let me set the scene: the dream always opens the same way, I'm standing alone at what seems to be a nearly endless expanse of farmland or a field of wheat. Way out in the distance is a tiny rundown shack that I feel drawn towards. Not *just* drawn towards, it's like I HAVE to go towards it and see what's inside. I start walking towards it, and as I'm crossing the field, I realize I'm running. When I arrive at the worn out old farm house I notice two things. There is no real front door only one of those screen storm doors, and standing behind it is a child. But it's not just any child... It's ME as a child, but .... Also not.... Like that's not really what I looked like as a child. There's something.... Off about them. But I just know that it's supposed to be me. They lead me inside and for some reason I let them. Here's where things get truly odd and a bit disturbing. I die in this dream. Every time. The layout of the house always changes. I've been in every room, and yet I haven't been into a single one. Each room represents a different way in which my time might come to an end. They're always changing and so these rooms don't really have "insides", only thresholds. Once I step inside a room, it's like I'm walking into a future that might come to be rather than an actual room. The girl, my odd little dream self, will take my hand and lead me to a different "room" each time, and we'll stand there together and watch yet another version of myself live an entire lifetime and then die in one way or another, and then when that life is over she'll turn to me silently, and lead me out of the room and to the front door. Only then will she speak. She always asks the same thing. "Why do you come back?" And then she opens the door and I leave and then I wake up. It's the weirdest ish every time.
